title: fed reserves / ample reserves / reserve management purchases | Speech Neutral | Reflections on the Early Days of Reserve Management Purchase...
summary: SOMA Manager Roberto Perli delivered a technical briefing on the Federal Reserve's transition from abundant to ample reserves, including the October 2025 decision to end balance sheet runoff and the December 2025 initiation of Reserve Management Purchases (RMPs). The speech documents a notable tightening in money market conditions through late 2025, characterized by declining ON RRP usage to de minimis levels, rising repo rates above IORB, increased repo rate volatility, and more frequent usage of Standing Repo Facilities (SRPs). Perli outlines the six indicators the Fed monitors to assess reserve adequacy and explains the mechanics of how ample reserves differ from abundant or scarce regimes in terms of rate sensitivity.
